boundary: Scope: the worked study driver + its bundle
Multi-actor means registration, evidence, adjudication, and control-relevant events carry distinct actors so the swap control can bite (Phase 5 lesson)

evidence.ref: Spec 003 §8 (worked study); DN-008 caveat 1 (single-actor swap-control lesson)
